hook: Some books don't just tell a story. They show you who's pulling the strings.
script_lines: It's what happens when AI stops serving us and starts owning us.
Every character you meet? Based on someone alive right now.
Every decision they make? Already happening behind closed doors.
The machines aren't coming. They're here.
And the people running them? They have names.
You just haven't heard them yet.
cta: Bloodline. Read it before it reads you.
